class.name: SpineTransformConstraint
class.brief_description: Stores the current pose for a transform constraint.
class.description: Stores the current pose for a transform constraint. A transform constraint adjusts the world transform of the constrained bones to match that of the source bone. See [url]http://esotericsoftware.com/spine-transform-constraints[/url] in the Spine User Guide.

method.name: get_bones
method.description: The bones that will be modified by this transform constraint. Modifying the array has no effect.

method.name: get_data
method.description: The transform constraint's setup pose data.

method.name: get_source
method.description: The source bone whose world transform will be copied to the constrained bones.

members.member: The transform constraint's setup pose data. A new wrapper may be returned on each access.
A snapshot of [SpineBonePose] wrappers for the bones modified by this constraint. Each access rebuilds the array; modifying the returned array does not change the constraint's bone collection.
The source bone whose world transform is copied to the constrained bones. A new wrapper may be returned on each access. Assigning [code]null[/code] is ignored and does not clear the current source.
The current transform constraint mix values. A new wrapper may be returned on each access.
The transform constraint pose last applied by the animation state. A new wrapper may be returned on each access.
Whether this transform constraint is applied when the skeleton's world transform is updated.
